description: This file provides Windows-specific implementations for memory mapping functions, including git_mmap and git_munmap, to handle file mapping on Win32 systems.

methods.name: void * git_mmap(void * start,size_t length,int prot,int flags,int fd,off_t offset)
methods.description: Maps a file into memory using Windows API functions, returning a pointer to the mapped region.

methods.name: int git_munmap(void * start,size_t length UNUSED)
methods.description: Unmaps a previously mapped memory region.
